audit.whatIsWrong: Rated TRICKY 7.5/10 with Poppy owning four of seven rows, against a 48.93% win rate — the only sub-50% matchup in this slice.
audit.why: Neeko out-ranges Poppy at every level (Q 800, E 1000 vs Heroic Charge 475) and has no melee window to punish; the lane is a spacing contest, not a Poppy-favoured one.
audit.corrected: Difficulty left at 7.5/10 (it already reflects the losing record), but the level chart no longer claims Poppy owns levels 3-5 or the first-item row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Neeko, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Neeko, Poppy, Poppy in both layers; the packet and the mirror both have Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Neeko, Neeko, Poppy.
audit.why: whys[2] says 'genuinely skill-matched', whys[3] says 'stay even', and whys[5] says she out-trades you on Lost Chapter into Liandry's — three rows whose own text contradicted the printed side.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3 and 5 flipped as one atomic paired group in both layers to Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Neeko, Neeko, Poppy, ratings realigned to 5/6/5/5/3/3/7.

audit.whatIsWrong: Repeated claims that Steadfast Presence deletes Neeko's dash and that holding W denies her engage. Neeko has no dash in lane — Shapesplitter sends a clone, it does not move her; her only leap is Pop Blossom itself.
audit.why: Telling a player to hold a 20s cooldown as a parry against an ability that does not exist costs them the trade. Two real interactions were absent instead: Tangle-Barbs (or Pop Blossom) cancels Keeper's Verdict, which is a channel; and Inherent Glamour's disguise breaks when she receives immobilising CC, so a Heroic Charge wall-stun unmasks a hidden Neeko.
audit.corrected: Dash-denial replaced with the Tangle-Barbs cooldown window (12-10s) and the channel-cancel warning; disguise-break added.
